mentions.name: Haskell miso app boilerplate
mentions.description: A Haskell (miso) app boilerplate setup built deliberately without generative AI, developed to form stronger opinions about how the frontend could be different and to learn techniques applicable to Next.js apps at work.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on building an app boilerplate setup I enjoy building with in Haskell (miso) with no generative AI. Mostly just to develop some stronger opinions about how the frontend _could_ be different, and maybe learn some tricks for more normal nextjs apps at day job.
